```yaml
name: Update Meeting Minutes

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Runs daily at midnight UTC

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-minutes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Fetch latest community post
        id: fetch
        run: |
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s https://discuss.layer5.io/c/community/latest.json)
          POST_RAW=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.post_stream.posts[0].raw')
          echo "post_raw<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$POST_RAW" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Write meeting minutes file
        run: |
          DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)
          FILE=".github/meetings/archive/${DATE}.md"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$FILE")"
          printf "%s" "${{ steps.fetch.outputs.post_raw }}" > "$FILE"

      - name: Commit and push if changed
        run: |
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          if git diff --quiet .github/meetings/archive; then
            echo "No changes to commit."
          else
            git add .github/meetings/archive
            git commit -m "Update meeting minutes for $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)"
            git push
          fi
```
